faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.q1: What exactly does your MEP design cover?
faq.a1: HyperMEP provides comprehensive design services for electrical, mechanical, and plumbing installations. This includes energy-efficient HVAC systems, complete high and low voltage installations, as well as sustainable water distribution and management systems.
faq.q2: How do you use BIM technology in your projects?
faq.a2: We use tools like Autodesk Revit and Navisworks to develop high-precision 3D models. Our main focus is advanced Clash Detection with architecture and structural engineering, resolving potential issues before they appear on site.
faq.q3: What types of facilities do you provide technical documentation for?
faq.a3: Our services cover a wide range of complex structures. We most commonly work on commercial office buildings, industrial plants, healthcare and educational facilities, data centers, and mixed-use developments.

about.title: About Us

company.title: About the Company
company.p1: HyperMEP is an independent engineering consulting company specializing in MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing Engineering) design, BIM modeling, and multidisciplinary technical coordination.
company.p2: Founded in 2023 in Pančevo, the company was created with the goal of combining modern engineering, digital technologies, and a high level of technical expertise to provide clients with reliable, sustainable, and efficient design solutions.
company.p3: The company was founded by Uroš Milenković, driven by the vision to create an engineering firm capable of meeting the challenges of the modern construction sector through an integrated approach to design, BIM coordination, and building performance optimization.

philosophy.title: Our Philosophy
philosophy.p1: We believe that top-tier projects are born when engineering precision, innovation, and collaboration unite in a single process. That is why we approach every project with a focus on:
list: optimization of investment and operational costs.
philosophy.p2: Our goal is not just to produce design documentation, but to create intelligent technical solutions that enhance building performance throughout their entire life cycle.

vision.title: Mission
vision.text: To become the leading regional partner for integrated MEP design and BIM coordination, recognized for technical excellence, innovative solutions, and a professional approach.

mission.title: Vision
mission.text: To create sustainable, efficient, and future-ready facilities that generate long-term value for our clients through top-tier engineering, digital technologies, and multidisciplinary collaboration.

services.title: Services
services.intro: HyperMEP provides comprehensive MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing engineering) engineering services, combining technical expertise, BIM methodology, and practical engineering solutions. Our goal is the development of efficient, sustainable, and reliable systems that meet the highest technical and regulatory standards.

s1.desc: We design energy-efficient systems that ensure optimal comfort, functionality, and long-term reliability of buildings.
